'''Evan Ferguson''' (GEMP handle '''Mame2'''; forum name '''Mame'''; also listed as '''Evan F''')<ref name="org2026">Email from Stephen Sanders to 2026 Retro League participants, 2026 (player name / GEMP handle / forum name list).</ref> finished 14th at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]], the highest finisher named who did not play Operatives.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]].</ref> Ferguson is a player in the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]].
